title: Strict Age
story: The registration form must refuse impossible ages.
goal: Write check_age(age) returning age if it is between 0 and 150, otherwise raising ValueError.
hints: Use if to detect a bad value, then raise ValueError("message").
The check is: age < 0 or age > 150.
socratic: Which keyword makes an error on purpose?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Strict Age”?
